overview: 13F filing day dominates: Burry, Nvidia, Citadel, Tepper, Druckenmiller, Bridgewater and others disclosed big moves, with SpaceX and chip stocks at the center. This comes as the Mag 7 sit about $4.6T below their highs and talk grows of Jensen Huang returning to Nvidia. Separately, SpaceX caught Starship 42 with the tower for the first time, and AI posts covered open models gaining share and Paul Christiano's stark superintelligence timeline.
